semantic_output: Ordered time-indexed plume sections in a named frame, including centerline pose, section size/support, and optional feature channels.
canonical_units: SI geometry; positions m; time s; dimensionless feature labels where applicable
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id; frame; time; ordered sections; centerline position; section orientation; section radius/axes; validity and claim metadata
allowed_derivations: conservative support; projected area; rendering mesh; ray-domain acceleration structure
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer spectral intensity, optical coefficients, local thermochemical state, or validated shock structure from appearance alone.
mvp_release_gate: Contract conformance plus a prescribed straight fixture; external feature-level baselines must be reported separately from full geometry validation.

semantic_output: Intrinsic unresolved source spectral radiant intensity J_lambda(t, direction), independent of observer range, atmosphere, and detector.
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id; time; source-to-observer direction; wavelength coordinate; J_lambda; validity; uncertainty/claims; provenance
allowed_derivations: spectral-band intensity; apparent irradiance after explicit range/path/detector adapters
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer plume geometry, per-ray radiance, optical depth, or local fields from an unresolved signature table.
mvp_release_gate: A deterministic versioned table provider may ship after the common API gate; external sensor-space evidence does not by itself validate intrinsic J_lambda.

semantic_output: Wavelength-resolved transfer along requested rays, preserving source radiance and background transmittance as separate outputs.
canonical_units: source radiance W m^-2 sr^-1 m^-1; transmittance dimensionless
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id; ray frame/origin/direction; wavelength coordinate; L_lambda_source; tau_lambda_background; status/mask; provenance
allowed_derivations: spectral images; detector products; projected-area integration to J_lambda when ray coverage is complete
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer full flow state or particle population unless the provider separately advertises those products.
mvp_release_gate: Analytic transfer tests plus at least one external line-of-sight spectral comparison and one optical-depth or surface-flux comparison.

semantic_output: Conservative plume support/bounds used for culling, ray-domain construction, hazard screening, and coupling.
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id; frame; conservative bound; time; derivation and claim metadata
allowed_derivations: ray candidate selection; broad-phase intersection; visualization bounds
prohibited_inferences: A conservative bound is not a plume contour, temperature boundary, or optical-depth contour.
mvp_release_gate: Every advertised support must contain all nonzero spatial/ray products for the same snapshot.

semantic_output: Local flow and thermochemical state at points, profiles, planes, zones, or imported-field samples.
canonical_units: SI pressure, temperature, density, velocity, species, and model-specific state units
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id; frame; coordinates; named state quantities with units; validity; fidelity/provenance
allowed_derivations: probe comparisons; flux sections; optical-medium construction when physics supports it
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat modeled RPA/CEA boundary states as measured plume fields.
mvp_release_gate: Unit/frame conformance, conservative handoff closure, and benchmark-specific point/profile comparisons.

semantic_output: Local or tabulated absorption, emission, scattering, and extinction properties needed by ray transfer.
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id or asset digest; wavelength; state dependence; coefficients; assumptions; provenance
allowed_derivations: ray transfer; optical depth; emissive source term
prohibited_inferences: Equivalent blackbody temperature is not automatically local gas temperature; abstract-level ranges are not radial fields.
mvp_release_gate: Reproducible assets, explicit particle/gas assumptions, and independent optical-scale checks.

semantic_output: Particle population state including size, velocity, temperature, composition, loading, and distribution semantics.
canonical_units: m, m s^-1, K, kg m^-3, and normalized distribution measures
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id or case_id; particle class/composition; distribution coordinates; weighting semantics; provenance
allowed_derivations: particle optical properties and multiphase coupling after explicit models
prohibited_inferences: Do not treat visible plotting windows, adaptive curve vertices, or analytical repeats as complete independent distributions.
mvp_release_gate: Particle zero-loading limit plus direct distribution/velocity checks with sampling operators.

semantic_output: Surface pressure, force, heat flux, temperature response, hazard envelopes, and related coupling observables.
canonical_units: Pa, N, W m^-2, K, m s^-1, and declared nondimensional coefficients
minimum_required_fields: snapshot_id/case_id; surface or sensor geometry; quantity; units; time/statistic; provenance
prohibited_inferences: Surface response is not local plume-gas state unless a conjugate response model is applied.
mvp_release_gate: Measurement-operator equivalence and source-specific uncertainty/response semantics.
